items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh wow, yeah. And he talks about old man Moret. [INTERVIEWEE] That's it, he played in the Excelsior band.

ctx.x: And this, Harrison, Vaughn, and Buddy Johnson was the trombone player. And T.O. played Clarence. Oh yeah. Young Till. Well Lewis played in that band too. Louis Armstrong.
Oh wow, yeah. And he talks about old man Moret.
That's it, he played in the Excelsior band. Yeah. Peter Bocards too played in the Excelsior band.
